description: Lint-only check on a real Mac: resolves the project/workspace/package and schemes with xcodebuild -list, parses every Swift file with swiftc (syntax, file:line:col), lints plists. Does NOT compile. Works without DS_API_KEY (keyless trial: 10 per day per address, 25 MB snapshot). Use this to validate structure before asking the user for a key; use build_sim/test_sim for a real build.

projectPath.description: Path to the .xcodeproj (omit for a workspace or a Swift package)

workspacePath.description: Path to the .xcworkspace (CocoaPods / React Native projects)

workspaceRoot.description: Directory to upload as the project root (default: the directory containing the project/workspace, or the current directory). Only files under it are sent.

name: check_project
title: Check project on a Mac (no API key needed)
